*[[2019 Luzon earthquake]]
**Eight people are killed when a magnitude 6.1 [[earthquake]] struck the towns of [[Porac, Pampanga|Porac]] and [[Lubao, Pampanga|Lubao]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/228731-death-toll-luzon-earthquake-april-22-2019 (Rappler)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]], [[Seth Moulton 2020 presidential campaign]]
**[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] for [[Massachusetts]] [[Seth Moulton]] announces he is running for the [[Democratic Party]]'s nomination to be [[President of the United States]] in the 2020 presidential election. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/04/22/politics/seth-moulton-2020-campaign-announcement/index.html (CNN)]
*[[United States sanctions against Iran]]
**The [[United States]] demands that all countries cease purchasing oil from [[Iran]] by May 1 or face sanctions, in a move aimed at reducing Iran's income. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-iran-oil/u-s-to-end-all-waivers-on-imports-of-iranian-oil-crude-price-jumps-idUSKCN1RX0R1 (Reuters)]
